title: Karl Compton recruits teenage Malmgren to MIT

tellings.quote: Two hours later, my father and said, "I want to take this boy out of your school. I want to come in September and metriculate in MIT

plain: Harold Malmgren, who later advised US presidents, says that around 1950, as a teenager, he met Karl Compton, a leading figure at MIT, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, at a mansion near Cambridge, Massachusetts. Malmgren says that after two hours of talking, Compton told his father he wanted to take the boy out of his school and have him enrol at MIT that September. He tells it to show how early he was drawn into elite scientific circles.
